name: 5-Amino-1MQ
subtitle: NNMT inhibitor, small molecule
summary: Oral NNMT inhibitor with intriguing fat-loss results in mice. Published human evidence: none.
caveat: Fat-loss results are in mice; there is no published human evidence at all.
